run_COLMAPProcessor_process: run the COLMAPProcessor process method to perform feature extraction, matching, and sparse or dense reconstruction
run_COLMAPProcessor_extract_features: run the COLMAPProcessor extract_features method to extract SIFT features from images into a COLMAP database
run_COLMAPProcessor_match: run the COLMAPProcessor match method to perform exhaustive or sequential feature matching on extracted features
run_COLMAPProcessor_dense: run the COLMAPProcessor dense method to perform undistortion and patch match stereo for dense depth reconstruction
run_COLMAPProcessor_map: run the COLMAPProcessor map method to build a sparse 3D reconstruction using the COLMAP mapper
